2026-08-31.patch_summary: This patch introduces per-page_counter stock to improve the efficiency of memcg charge and limit checks. The current implementation uses per-cpu stocks, which can lead to expensive hierarchy walks and inefficient cache management. By pushing stock caches down to the page_counter level, each counter is responsible for its own charge, addressing issues such as limited cache capacity, per-CPU draining, and tight coupling with memcg. This change allows for more scalable and efficient handling of page counters.
